name: Polyplast
note: Founder of HC Lada (club partners page, 2026/27) and a jersey sponsor: logo on both shorts legs, wordmark across the lower back of the 2026-27 home kit. Ownership is private per the audited 2025 IFRS statements (claim polyplast-owners), but there is a possible company finding under METHOD.md's company test: on 16 January 2019 an explosion at the group's wholly-owned Kingisepp production plant (ООО «Полипласт Северо-Запад», 100% subsidiary per the IFRS statements) injured four or five workers; the Investigative Committee opened a criminal case (Article 217 of the Criminal Code), the Leningrad Oblast prosecutor's office brought four administrative cases against the company and its officials for fire-safety and labour-law violations, and the plant was fined about 239,000 rubles (forpost-sz.ru and mayaksbor.ru, 01.02.2019; claim polyplast-kingisepp-2019-explosion). ON HOLD: if that counts as a regulator finding of injuries it is 'concern'; a maintainer decides.
